prose: At its first Config event in India, Figma announced features to define how AI agents work in its tools. The main one, Figma Specs, is a Markdown editor where teams write down their design language as a reference for people and agents.
Specs can be a standalone file or live inside a design, and Figma also announced a Payload CMS integration.
highlights: Figma Specs lets teams document design rules for agents in Markdown.
Adds a Payload headless CMS integration.
